comparison_tracks.description: Measure whether four concise 1-line '# INVARIANT:' why-comments across a 6-module job-queue package prevent silent breakage of unstated cross-file crash/replay invariants relative to zero-comment code.
Measure whether defective commented-out code blocks and stale contradictory comments poison multi-file refactoring when subtle cross-file invariants are not restated in the prompt.
Measure the full controlled accuracy and latency spread between crisp cross-file invariant comments and comment-trap pollution across all four focus models.

limits: Planned 36-run multi-file comment-hygiene ablation designed to eliminate CM1's 12/12 accuracy ceiling by withholding the two subtle cross-file invariants from the task prompt.
All three variants share 100% identical executable Python AST across all 6 production modules (verified by benchmarks/graders/grade_cm2.py --check-ablation-fixtures).
100% mechanically graded by benchmarks/graders/grade_cm2.py with zero word caps or subjective rubric scoring.
